result.title: Any2Building: Unifying Point Clouds and Images for Building Reconstruction via Shared Spatial Queries
result.summary: Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Partial point clouds and overhead images of the same building provide incomplete 3D surface measurements and visual cues to its footprint, roof geometry, and rooftop structures, respectively. This motivates a unified framework that aligns geometric and visual cues in 3D and reconstructs buildings from either or both modalities. Building on this connection, we present Any2Building, a unified model for Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both, with optional coarse geometric priors. At its core is an occupancy-grounded shared spatial queries representation that organizes available observations within a common 3D grid. Supervised by complete building surface voxels, these queries connect observational evidence to target geometry, enabling a shared generator to learn structural priors across tasks and providing spatial guidance for recovering missing structure. A trained voxel conditional surface-generation and low-poly remeshing pipeline then converts the predicted structure into compact LoD2 building models. To support this framework, we introduce BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one million paired samples of partial point clouds, overhead images, and LoD2 building models across 18 cities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Any2Building outperforms existing methods in geometric reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image building generation, and prior-assisted generation, while maintaining detailed and robust recovery when point cloud input modality is degraded.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向 LoD2 建筑重建，提出 Any2Building 统一框架，可从部分点云、俯视图像或两者重建建筑，并以占用监督的共享空间查询在公共 3D 网格中组织可用观测，再由体素条件生成与低模重建流程输出紧凑模型，同时构建了约百万样本的 BuildingWorld-Image 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「占用grounded 共享空间查询」把多模态部分证据绑定到统一 3D 栅格并由完整表面监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、缺失信息与内部状态表示的关系提供可核查的结构化线索，但任务本身是几何重建而非多模态推理。
